speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and the lesion's evolution, I need to rule out specific inflammatory conditions. speaker: Doctor
text: The history of an ant bite at the site, combined with violaceous borders and underlying Crohn's disease, strongly suggests pyoderma gangrenosum triggered by trauma. I will now request imaging to better characterize the extent of the ulcer and rule out other causes. REQUEST IMAGES
